item.name: 06. Listing Images

request.description: Generate a presigned upload URL to upload an image directly to S3 / Object Storage. Validates listing ownership, max 10 images limit, MIME type (JPEG, PNG, WebP), and file size (max 5MB).
Direct binary upload to S3 / Object Storage using the presigned URL returned from 'Presign Listing Image Upload'. Set Body to 'Binary' or 'File' and select your JPEG/PNG/WebP image file.

Confirm that direct S3 upload completed. Verifies that the object exists in storage, validates image format/magic bytes and size, saves the image record to PostgreSQL, and queues background processing for EXIF/metadata stripping.
